properties.description:
Route board requests through the frontend engine, acquire the entities backing fetched cards without selection, and expose them to Graph editor. Reuse unchanged loaded ranges when returning; handle revisions, deletion and partial coverage explicitly. Record the reported sequence before replacing behavior.

Implementation progress: planning reads now return owner-selected canonical acquisitions through the engine operation protocol; browser planning, annotations and hub use the local engine connection. Removed dedicated planning and graph HTTP routes. Recorded before/after unit scenarios cover unselected cards, bounded coverage, unchanged revisit, refresh/deletion, actor isolation and current versus historical revisions. Focused Activity board → Graph → Activity board browser test passes with both fetched entries retained and zero additional planning reads. Personal template profile browser regression also passes. Remaining: complete revision/coverage invalidation semantics and integration with shared-tab engine work; final impacted tests and checkpoint pending.

Slice verification completed: Canonical acquisition now includes unselected fetched cards. Recorded Activity board → Graph → Activity board preserves acquired entities and performs no additional unchanged planning reads. Owner tests cover bounded pages, deletion/replacement, actor context and historical reads.
properties.title: Make Activity board acquisition shared and reusable
